name: K-Fold Cross-Validated Ensemble
description: Replaces a single model_training node with a k-fold cross-validation loop that produces k models and out-of-fold predictions for stacking. The most common Kaggle technique — nearly every winning tabular solution uses 5-fold CV.

with_nodes.name: split_folds
with_nodes.description: Split training data into k folds using stratified splitting

with_nodes.name: train_fold_models
with_nodes.description: Train one model per fold on the fold's training split. Produces k models and k out-of-fold prediction arrays.
with_nodes.notes: Out-of-fold predictions are used for stacking. Each sample appears exactly once in the OOF predictions.

notes: After expansion, the prediction_ensemble node receives k models instead of 1. OOF predictions can feed a meta-learner (see stacking expansion).
